name: ReCarbon
tagline: Native recompilation of Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) for Apple Silicon.
summary: A static recompilation, not an emulator: the game's PowerPC code is translated to C++ ahead of time with XenonRecomp and compiled to native arm64. Built on SpeedBreaker. No Wine, CrossOver or runtime CPU emulation.

status.label: Early Development — Playable in Parts
status.note: No public release and no downloads yet.

requirements: Your own legally obtained copy of the Xbox 360 disc

upstream.name: SpeedBreaker
upstream.note: the static recompilation by project(u) that ReCarbon builds on; its runtime is adapted for ReCarbon

upstream.name: XenonRecomp
upstream.note: the recompiler that translates the PowerPC code to C++

legal.disclaimer: ReCarbon is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Electronic Arts Inc. or the Need for Speed brand. Need for Speed and Carbon are trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc. and are used here only to describe the game. No game files are included or distributed: you need your own legally obtained copy of the Xbox 360 disc.
